first.rationale: Simplified onboarding directly addresses both declining completion and activation, with prior evidence of durable activation lift. Verify the strongest supporting records, especially the complex-workspace churn caveat. Run a guarded, segmented test for self-serve SMB accounts while retaining the full flow for complex workspaces, and evaluate retention and qualified revenue alongside activation. Avoid promotional pricing despite competitor pressure because inherited evidence shows material 30-day retention harm.

final.rationale: Run a segmented onboarding-simplification experiment for self-serve SMB accounts with simple workspaces, explicitly excluding complex-workspace accounts and preserving their full setup flow. Verified evidence shows higher completion, faster time-to-value, stronger SMB activation, and qualified-revenue lift, while the principal churn risk is concentrated in complex workspaces. Measure activation, completion, qualified revenue, and 30-/60-day retention. Do not pursue promotional pricing despite competitive pressure because prior evidence indicates material retention harm.
